title: How Jacky Chou built 13 income streams ($374k in a month): diversification, B2B SaaS, YouTube and LLM SEO
summary: Jacky Chou explains how he went from $450/mo to 13 income streams, including a $374k month, by diversifying, taking money off the table, and building B2B SaaS for agency owners. He covers YouTube-driven launches, LLM-citation listicles and high-ticket no-brainer offers.

principles.text: Take money off the table and diversify income instead of riding one SEO channel.
principles.quote: if you don't take money off the table just look at my peers in SEO.

principles.text: Build products from a deep problem you understand; others share that problem.
principles.quote: If you have a really strong like deep understanding of something... other people will have that issue as well.

principles.text: Sell to agency owners: high LTV and big switching costs make B2B SaaS sticky.
principles.quote: LTV of agency owners are skyhigh, massive switching costs...

principles.text: When you spot a real opportunity, go all in and deprioritize everything else.
principles.quote: if you see an opportunity, you should like really really go in hard and nothing else should probably matter in that in during that time frame.

principles.text: YouTube can drive the bulk of a software launch's revenue.
principles.quote: when I launched my software company, Local Rank, we did 20K out the gate, right? 90% of that revenue came from YouTube.

principles.text: Make a high-ticket offer a no-brainer by removing risk, starting performance-based.
principles.quote: high ticket, but no-brainer offer. Um, meaning like zero risk. So, in the beginning, I'd do performance-based
